Short description: A 2-way connector (also known as a 2-pin or 2-pole connector) is a fundamental electrical component designed to join two wires or circuits together. It consists of a matched male (plug) and female (receptacle) pair that allows for a secure, yet disconnectable, electrical path..
Description:
A 2-way connector (also known as a 2-pin or 2-pole connector) is a fundamental electrical component designed to join two wires or circuits together. It consists of a matched male (plug) and female (receptacle) pair that allows for a secure, yet disconnectable, electrical path.

Core Components

  • Housing: Usually made of plastic or nylon, this provides insulation and structural support.

  • Terminals/Pins: The conductive metal parts (often tin, gold, or silver-plated) that physically touch to transfer electricity.

    Locking Mechanism: Many 2-way connectors feature a “click-lock” or friction fit to prevent the wires from pulling apart due to vibration.
